name: Rosetta Halloway
source:
The titular heroine, a young woman who lives alone with her pet cat.

She notices a strange well in her backyard one day and investigates, which leads to her first encounter with Galatea of the Well.

[spoiler]A few months after vanquishing the demon Pygmalion, she ends up getting married to her boyfriend Christopher.[/spoiler]
